statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ q x : ℕ, 0<q → 2≤x → |(∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => q ∣ n^2+1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) - ((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)*x/(Nat.totient q : ℝ)| ≤ C*((roots 1 q).card : ℝ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.log (4*(q : ℝ)*x)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0024 · 在 GRH 下估计根余类中的 Mangoldt 质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0024 · Estimate Mangoldt mass in the root classes under GRH

brief.zh: 每个根都是单位。分别估计各个根余类的 ψ 差，再累加同一个绝对常数。
brief.en: Every root is a unit. Sum the dyadic progression estimates with one absolute constant.
